headline_marked: [[Groom dies day before wedding]] in Gaibandha, celebrations turn to mourning
headline: Groom dies day before wedding in Gaibandha, celebrations turn to mourning
summary: Arif Shahriar Soumik, a 21-year-old North South University graduate, passed away unexpectedly just one day before his wedding. His sudden death has plunged both families into deep sorrow, halting all preparations for the joyous occasion.
details: Wedding preparations were in full swing at the bride's house, with an illuminated gate and decorated homes, while the groom's family also anticipated the festivities. However, the joy turned to profound sorrow in an instant when groom Arif Shahriar Soumik (21) died the day before his wedding.

The news of Soumik's death reached the bride's house on Thursday evening, immediately halting all wedding arrangements. Meanwhile, at Soumik's home in David Company Para, Gaibandha town, relatives, neighbors, and well-wishers were left in shock and grief.
Soumik was a brilliant student, having graduated from North South University with a first-class second position in Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE).

According to relatives, Soumik had returned home from Dhaka about a month ago. He had been suffering from a fever for the past four days. On Thursday morning, around 9 AM, he was taken to a private diagnostic center opposite Gaibandha District Sadar Hospital due to an abnormally high body temperature.

After receiving medication, his relatives brought him back home. However, his physical condition deteriorated further in the afternoon. He was then rushed to Gaibandha District Sadar Hospital around 5:30 PM, where doctors declared him dead.
His family could not confirm whether Soumik's death was caused by dengue fever. The sudden demise has cast a deep shadow of grief over his family and relatives.
The house that was buzzing with preparations for a wedding celebration is now filled with mourning and the lamentations of loved ones, a stark contrast to the joy that was anticipated.

headline_marked: [[Cocktail explosion]] in front of NCP office in Bangla Motor, Dhaka
headline: Cocktail explosion in front of NCP office in Bangla Motor, Dhaka
summary: A cocktail explosion occurred near the National Citizens' Party (NCP) central office in Bangla Motor, Dhaka, late Thursday night. Police later defused two unexploded cocktails found at the scene.
details: Three cocktails were thrown by motorcyclists at the National Citizens' Party (NCP) central office in Bangla Motor, Dhaka, around 12:30 AM on Thursday night. One of the cocktails exploded upon impact.
Two other cocktails remained unexploded at the scene. Police officials arrived shortly after the incident and successfully defused the two unexploded devices.
The incident was reported by the NCP through a press release sent to journalists via a WhatsApp group at 1:55 AM. No casualties or significant damage were immediately reported.
